document.title: Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers' Rights Act, 2001
document.authority: Protection of Plant Varieties and Farmers' Rights Authority (PPV&FRA)

sections.section_title: Registerable Varieties - Distinctiveness, Uniformity and Stability (DUS)
sections.content: Section 15 provides that a new plant variety of medicinal or aromatic plants may be registered if it satisfies DUS criteria: Novelty, Distinctiveness, Uniformity, and Stability based on official DUS testing protocols.

sections.section_title: Rights of Breeder and Farmers' Rights
sections.content: Section 28 confers exclusive right on the breeder to produce, sell, market, distribute, import or export the registered variety. Section 39 safeguards farmers' rights to save, use, sow, re-sow, exchange, or share farm produce including seeds of protected varieties.
